customers.description: Primary B2B account master table with firmographics, consent, and assigned AM.

fields.region: Geographic territory across Americas, Europe, APAC
fields.lead_source: Origination channel (ERP Referral, Summit, Organic, ABM)
fields.acquisition_date: Date account record was created in CRM
fields.consent_email: Channel opt-in consent flag (1 = Consented, 0 = Suppressed)
fields.consent_whatsapp: WhatsApp opt-in consent flag (1 = Consented, 0 = Suppressed)

transactions.description: Historical contract and project billing records for i95Dev services.

fields.service_category: Delivered service type (ERP integration, Adobe Commerce, Portal, Managed Retainer)
fields.contract_status: State of contract (Completed, Active Retainer, Expired)
fields.renewal_date: Next upcoming retainer renewal date if active
fields.repeat_purchase_count: Cumulative purchases count prior to this deal

sales_interactions.description: Granular touchpoint logs across email, whatsapp, meetings, and demos.

fields.interaction_type: Touchpoint category (Discovery, Tech Review, Proposal, Demo)
fields.demo_attended: 1 if live technical integration demo took place
fields.proposal_sent: 1 if formal RFP/SOW proposal was delivered

support_tickets.description: Technical support, integration maintenance, and SLA resolution tracking.

fields.issue_category: Integration domain issue (Sync latency, Webhook, Auth, Pricing rule)
fields.ticket_status: Current case status (Resolved, Closed, In Progress, Escalated)

pipeline_opportunities.description: Current and past commercial opportunities in sales pipeline.

fields.sales_stage: Stage (Discovery, Tech Review, Solution Design, Proposal Sent, Negotiation, Closed)

message_campaign_logs.description: Complete audit trail of simulated automated follow-ups, statuses, and simulated customer reactions.

fields.trigger_reason: Rule or behavioral anomaly that fired the message
fields.generated_message: Rendered message content with customer context
fields.simulated_status: Simulated lifecycle status (Queued, Scheduled, Sent, Replied, Converted, Suppressed)
fields.opt_out_status: 1 if client opted out or was suppressed
